verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents an official Java SDK that gives convenient access to the full API. That is a genuine vendor-provided client library, but it is the only one evidenced. The other languages are covered only by code samples, which are not client libraries. missing for 10: official SDKs for other mainstream languages (e.g. Python, Node, PHP, .NET), evidence of versioning/release history, evidence of ongoing vendor maintenance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official client libraries exist for mainstream languages, versioned and maintained by the vendor

citations.quote: Use our official Java SDK for convenient access to all features of the API. Requires Java 8 or later.
